prompt: Rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures a bustling snowy town square. In the center stands a tall stone fountain, its basin filled with ice. To the left of the fountain, a man in a red scarf holds a steaming mug. Next to him sits a small child in a blue coat, looking up at the man. A brown dog lies on the snow beside the child, resting its head on its paws. On the right side of the square, a woman in a green hat points toward the distant clock tower. Standing next to her is a tall lamppost, casting a faint shadow. Perched on the lamppost is a black crow, watching the scene below. Near the base of the lamppost, an old wooden bench holds a sleeping cat. Behind the bench, a vendor in a striped apron hands a paper bag to a customer in a grey jacket. The customer smiles while holding the bag tightly. In the background, a horse-drawn carriage waits patiently, the horse wearing a bell around its neck. The driver, wrapped in a thick fur coat, sits atop the carriage holding the reins. A young girl in a pink dress runs past the carriage, chasing a rolling hoop. An elderly man with a cane walks slowly near the edge of the square, observing the activity. A large evergreen tree stands in the far corner, decorated with simple ornaments. There is no modern vehicle visible in the scene. There is no digital signage or electronic screen present anywhere.
